shape.kinds: array length exactly3; strings from closed set; position i nonempty iff source_mask bit i set

source_positions: observation.service_nodes declared order; source positions are not node identity until bound to unchanged config declaration
invalid_shape_or_foreign_text: do not publish values; retain immutable raw diagnostic privately and report fixed projection-invalid marker
missing_optional_field: explicit missing; no inferred failure kind
future_implementation: bounded offline extraction after terminal cleanup; no new run probe, service request or runtime behavior change

optional_parse_reasons.shape: if present, exactly three short <=64-byte strings within <=1024-byte optional field; only positions with kind parse may be nonempty; else optional vector absent
optional_parse_reasons.malformed_optional: do not publish arbitrary text; omit optional parse_reasons independently and preserve valid mask/kinds
optional_parse_reasons.null_or_missing: absent; never infer a parser leaf
